entities.title: Design documents
entities.summary: The clean-room documents the code is written from: DESIGN, RULES, GDD, ART-BIBLE and UI-DESIGN, with their example screens.
entities.purpose: Holds create-retro-game's approved documents for LodeStar. RULES is the behaviour spec every rule in src/ cites; the GDD holds the names, data and decisions; DESIGN the architecture and layout; ART-BIBLE and UI-DESIGN the look, the HUD and the screens. images/ and screens/ hold example screens and renders that the documents and README show.
boundaries: Implementers read only these documents and the knowledge documents beside the code.
The .gdignore keeps Godot from importing anything here.
